title: RVG walkthroughs and verification
summary: Most examples simply note writers using RVG to walk customers through settings, verify concerns, or capture documentation, with only one clearly negative mention and too little evaluative detail to assess broader sentiment.

negative.summary: The only negative example says RVG access was used to document an issue rather than describing successful resolution.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mainly record RVG being used or attempted for walkthroughs, settings verification, feature activation, navigation help, and image capture without clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: Nearly all sampled fragments are procedural notes with no explicit customer evaluation, so sentiment is largely undetermined.
The topic centers on a service method rather than a single vehicle issue, spanning verification, feature walkthroughs, and documentation tasks.
